title: Higher dimensional local class field theory
summary: In this largely expository article we give an introduction to higher dimensional local class field theory, more precisely class field theory for smooth projective schemes over local fields. We begin with a quick summary of some of the main results of classical local class field theory. Then we explain the main definitions and statements in the higher dimensional setting. We give a new and simple proof of the $\ell$-part, which is originally due to Jannsen--Saito and Forré.
